article.story: SPARTANBURG, S.C. -- — Asa Thomas' 18 points helped Furman defeat Wofford 76-67 on Saturday. Thomas shot 6 for 9, including 6 for 7 from beyond the arc for the Paladins (18-11, 9-7 Southern Conference). Alex Wilkins added 15 points and five assists while going 5 of 15 from the floor, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and 4 for 4 from the free-throw line. Cooper Bowser shot 5 of 6 from the field and 3 for 6 from the foul line to finish with 13 points, while adding seven rebounds. Kahmare Holmes led the Terriers (18-11, 10-6) with 20 points. Wofford also got 13 points, 10 rebounds and three steals from Cayden Vasko. Rex Stirling finished with 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
